status.subtitle: Maturity today, estimated and observed.

status.emptyHint: Record a planting from the Varieties screen.
status.rulesEstimated: As of {{date}}. Estimated — Ready for harvest: the harvest window is open and no pre-harvest interval runs on the block. Ripe: the window opens within {{days}} days, or it is open while an interval runs. Immature: the window opens later.
status.rulesObserved: Observed: the latest field observation of the season under way. An observation made between two seasons counts for the next one. It takes precedence over the estimate until the last day of that season, given as “Counts until” under the observation. A running pre-harvest interval holds Ready for harvest back to Ripe, observed or estimated.
status.rulesWindow: Harvest window: from the first month of the season in which the trees give a yield, to the end of the season, as in the forecast. First harvest: the first harvest recorded in the open window; earlier pickings are listed under Recorded harvests. A dash means no value.

calendar.missingDateZalka: Planting date not recorded in the reference study (Zalka 2025 gives only “beginning of the rainy season”). Tree age and growth phase are computed from the planting date and cannot be shown until it is recorded.
calendar.missingDate: Planting date not entered yet. Tree age and growth phase are computed from the planting date and appear once it is entered.
calendar.legend: Age bands of the growth phases, from the Zalka 2025 study: 0–2 yrs establishment · 3–5 yrs gradual production · 6+ yrs full production. The study gives “years 5 to 7” for full production: year 5 is counted as gradual production, and full production continues after year 7. The share of the full yield in each phase, with its source, is under Reference values on <page>Harvest & Maturity</page>.
